Results.ReviewText: I purchased my first Weber11 years ago. It was good for 10 years. Last August 2019, I purchased the newest version of the Spirit lI E210. Results.ReviewText:
Well I have had 2 other Weber gas grills in a span of 28 years.  The cooking guide for some items are vague at best.  ie: You don't list the different times for beef for desired wellness.   I think your people have gotten a little lazy and have cheapen the overall product.  I still have the best booklet from my 1st gas Weber but it contradicts the one I received with my new grill.  Also miss my 3 burners, however it was my choice to downsize as it just the 2 of us, now.  Lastly, cooling down to medium heat is a chore....well I guess is that you have cheapened up that mechanism as well.
I think it will be time for a brand change the next time.
Results.Title: Cheapen product and cooking guide!!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This isn't my first gas grill, but it is my first Weber.  And what a difference.  I puchased this 2 burner Spitit II grill from my local garden store where they offered free assmmbly and delivery. The grill is just the right size for my needs. I like the built in gage that will let me know when the LP gas is running low and needs to be replaced. No more guessing if I have enough gas to get through a meal. I am impressed by how thick sturdy the cooking grates are, much better than the old rusted grill I am replacing.  But what I really love is that I didn't just get a grill, I got the Weber company's support and knowlegde of how to actually cook properly on a gas grill. For years all I ever had was a charchoal grill where you just waited for the coals to get hot and then you put the food on the grate and that was that. Even with my old gas grill I never thought to do anything different.  But then I read some of the grilling tips on the Weber sight when I regisered my grill, and I learned about direct and indirect heat, and setting the temperature for the right foods, and using something other than just aluminum foil to keep food from falling through the grates. So I have now learned, thanks to Weber.com, to use a cast iron skillet to cook my fish, and how to do ribs in foil in one hour, and cook veggies properly. As a result I am using the grill much more often and enjoying the pleasures of eating on my deck and look forward to trying many more of the recipes on Weber.com
Results.Title: I love my Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I am not your average grill master; I am a 64 year old widow.  I bought this grill for two reasons, one because I really enjoyed grilled foods and two because most of the grilled dishes I enjoy are healthier. The problem is, I was never the griller; my husband was. I had no idea how where to start, but I was determined to figure it out.  I began my research.  I shopped and compared and read reviews...I really did my homework. If I was going to do this, I wanted a user-friendly quality grill that I could really enjoy that was not too big or too small.  Along came the Weber Spirit II E-210 gas grill. Absolutely everything about it is perfect for me. Assembly was easy with a well-explained assembly manual, as was the start up process. I did it all by myself. I registered my grill which is more like joining a family; the Weber family.  I read about care, I was provided recipes, and mostly I felt like I had someone to contact with questions if needed.  I have not had any questions. Weber makes it so easy; you are virtually guaranteed success. I grill on my Spirit II multiple times a week.  I use their tools and grill accessories and have even expanded my menu. Clean up is a breeze; I use the Weber grill spray when cooking and cleaner after. If a 64 year old widow with no grilling experience can do this, anyone can. To be honest, my family is shocked. Family members with plenty of grilling experience are now trading in old grills for Weber grills.  I really wish I could better explain what a positive experience this has been.  Without any hesitation, I highly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: First-time "griller" as a 64 year old widow

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: You may pay more for a Weber, but it certainly is worth it.  The customer service is top notch and they stand behind their product 100%.  The grill gets instantly hot and cooks all my items perfectly.  I would highly recommend this product!
Results.Title: Excellent grill - highest quality.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
